notes.title: Update 0.8.5.0 is live now!
notes.notes:
We've been hard at work for the past month and here's what's new for version 0.8.5.0!

[list]
[*]Tweaked how Jon works in battle. 
[/list]His max TP is now 1000 and he keeps his TP between battles. "Enrage" and almost all of his moves now use TP, and if he maxes out on TP, he has a chance to either automatically go into a full rage, perform a super move and drain his TP all at once, or pass out from the stress.

[list]
[*] Added LOTS of new lore books. 
[/list]
The Newham library is quickly filling up with books that give players a glimpse at the lore and backstory of the world of Neria.

[list]
[*] Added voice lines to the main characters!
[/list] 
This is a trial run of something we've had brewing in the background for a while now. All the main characters have voice clips to go along with their dialogue through Chapter 5. Please let us know what you think!

[list]
[*]Added flavor text and interactions with many objects throughout the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.8.3.2A Released!
notes.notes:
Version 0.8.3.2A is a hotfix to address an issue in the beginning of chapter 11. If a certain character was knocked out at the end of chapter 10, starting the part of chapter 11 where they are the only party member would result in an instant game over.

We apologize to any players this bug affected. If you have a save in chapter 11 from before the bug, your existing saves will still work.

notes.title: Version 0.8.3.2 Released!
notes.notes:
Three weeks since release, and we've received some great feedback from players! 

Version 0.8.3.2 is another minor update that fixes some major issues in the previous version and adds some additional life and lore into the world of Neria.

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue during the Jandar side quest where if the party formation is changed during the void scene, Jon may not get re-added correctly to the party, resulting in the imp battle not playing out properly.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950679/2a1af778d68a286d3ac901ecaab6eeecbb80ae8f.png[/img]
[*] Corrected a continuity error within Stenobar's character bio.
[*] Tweaked the intro to chapter 2 to align with Jon's character bio.
[*] Fixed an issue with controller detection.
[*] Disabled mouse interaction to avoid issues where the mouse may accidentally hover over an enemy or menu option and disrupt the player's input.
[*] Fixed options that are meant to be on by default not being enabled.
[*] Fixed an issue where getting hit by a car in Newham City would calculate the damage incorrectly, leaving Stenobar with a fractional HP count.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950679/d650d0acec54320d55a13a40b31789ea53204a3a.png[/img]
[*] Fixed an issue related to the framerate, which caused the in-game timer to run much faster than intended. This also affected the speedrun mode.
[*] Fixed an issue with Mika having duplicate "Quiver" commands in battle and being unable to attack at all without a weapon.
[*] Fixed Frenz forgetting Autumn Fang.
[*] Fixed Alisha forgetting her special moves.
[*] Added more books to the Newham Library.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950679/b1dad0b07d34b2c59b6c619f8cc32fa3e80abf8e.png[/img]
[*] Fixed an issue with the renderer that caused the visuals to freeze but the game to continue in the background as normal.
[*] Added unique interactions with some NPCs in the early chapters.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950679/812e58c8ae7a3fbccb74d1ce0e116d297b8835cf.png[/img]
[*] Added flavor text to certain items in early game interiors.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.8.3.1 Released!
notes.notes:
It has been an exciting first week since release, and we have been hard at work making Aqatillion the best experience it can be.

Version 0.8.3.1 is a minor update that makes the following changes:

[list]
[*] Added NPCs throughout the game to fill in some of the more empty-feeling towns.
[*] Added more loot to find in Ginshire to address issues that some players were having during Chapter 5.
[*] Fixed typos and continuity errors throughout the game.
[*] Updated the rendering engine to a newer version of PIXI.js, which should improve performance slightly for some players.
[*] Re-added lighting effects from earlier beta builds that broke before release.
[/list]
